rationale: I read the complete held EO 8751 (6 FR 2301, May 7, 1941): establishes the Division of Defense Aid Reports in the Office for Emergency Management, its Executive Officer, duties (sec. 2) and administrative arrangements; no own term (the machine 'condition' hit at sec. 2 is the 'subject to such policies as the President may prescribe' wording, not a term). I read the held EO 8926 (6 FR 5519, Oct. 30, 1941, signed Oct. 28, 1941, 'Establishing the Office of Lend-Lease Administration'): sec. 1 creates the Office of Lend-Lease Administration and sec. 5 states 'Executive Order No. 8751 of May 2, 1941, establishing the Division of Defense Aid Reports and defining its functions and duties, is hereby revoked.' The revocation is express and whole, with no savings clause. Earlier endings: none; the order was not amended in the history. D6 (later events): the history's other relation, 'See: EO 8839' (July 30, 1941, Economic Defense Board): I searched held EO 8839 and it never names EO 8751, so it neither amends nor ends it; EO 8817 (July 5, 1941) cites EO 8751 only as authority for a Division regulation and does not change it; no held order names EO 8751 after EO 8926 (searched) so there is no revival. The OFR 'Revoked by: EO 8926' note and the revocation event agree with the held acting text. Provisional NO hypothesis only.
